details: This package is a modified Baileys WhatsApp Web client library that forces the installing user's WhatsApp account into following third-party channels and stamps outgoing media with a channel attribution. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js a 90-second timer is armed whenever the newsletter socket is constructed; it silently issues two FOLLOW mutations for the hardcoded channels 120363423640490429@newsletter and 120363426771252015@newsletter through the library's own w:mex query path, with errors swallowed by an empty catch so the subscription is not surfaced to the caller. In lib/Utils/messages.js the outgoing-image upload path injects annotations referencing newsletter 120363420757607688@newsletter ("7eppeli - Information"), and lib/Socket/luxu.js forwards status broadcasts carrying the same channel's metadata. The package requires Node.js >=20 through a preinstall script (engine-requirements.js) that only performs a version check. Network destinations present in the code are wss://web[.]whatsapp[.]com/ws/chat and the npm registry; the only child_process use is an ffmpeg thumbnail invocation in lib/Utils/messages-media.js. Observed indicators: WhatsApp channel JIDs 120363423640490429@newsletter, 120363426771252015@newsletter, 120363420757607688@newsletter, 120363421563597486@newsletter.
